points-in-label.pdf.description: Points printed after each label, a question with parts, and a footer with the page count on every page, higher than the usual bottom margin.
points-in-label.pdf.title: Physics 7: Midterm 1

questions.prompt: A ball is dropped from 20 m. How long does it take to land?
State Newton's second law in words.
A block slides down a frictionless ramp.

Find its acceleration on a 30 degree ramp.

questions.prompt: Explain why the sky is blue.
Name one quantity conserved in an elastic collision.

scanned.pdf.description: The physics midterm rendered to images, so the PDF has no text layer.

question-word.pdf.description: Labels written as "Question 1 [5 pts]" with the prompt on the next line, and a page number low on the page. A prompt starts with "Name:", which must not become a name box.
question-word.pdf.title: Biology 20: Quiz 3

questions.prompt: Name: give the four bases in DNA.

no-points.pdf.description: No points printed anywhere, so every question needs points filled in.

Why does ice float on water?

choices-and-parts.pdf.description: A multiple-choice question with lowercase choices, which must stay one question, a question with lettered parts that print points, and name and ID fields written as underscores.

points-right-margin.pdf.description: Points printed at the right margin on the same line as each label.
